title: Mango Pluck Arp
description: A bright FM pluck arpeggio in the mid-high register that climbs and falls through tropical scale shapes, with per-note filter bite and ping-pong delay throws. FM index and harmonicity drift on long mutually-prime LFO clocks (7, 13, 16, 24 cycles) while the scale steps and pan breathe, so the hook never settles — it shimmers and evolves from crisp staccato to richer, slightly washy overtones and back.
code:
setcpm(98/4)
stack(
  n("0 2 4 7 4 2 0 4 2 7 4 0 2 4 7 2")
    .scale("<C:major D:minor C:major F:major>/4")
    .s("sine")
    .octave("<4 4 5 4>/16")
    .fm(sine.slow(13).range(2, 8))
    .fmh("<1 2 1.5 1 0.75>/4")
    .attack(0.003).decay(0.15).sustain(0.08).release(0.07)
    .lpf(sine.slow(7).range(800, 5200))
    .resonance(sine.slow(24).range(4, 14))
    .lpenv(sine.slow(17).range(2, 6)).lpattack(0.002).lpdecay(0.12)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.15, 0.85))
    .delay("0.5:0.375:0.6")
    .off(0.5, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.22).pan(sine.slow(13).range(0.8, 0.2)))
    .room(0.25)
    .gain(0.85)
)
